# Vagon

> > Vagon provides cloud-powered solutions for streaming 3D applications and running high-performance virtual desktops with NVIDIA RTX GPUs.

Vagon offers two main products: Vagon Streams for pixel streaming Unreal Engine and Unity applications to browsers, and Vagon cloud desktops for creative professionals using Blender, Premiere Pro, and other GPU-intensive software. The platform serves freelancers, teams, and developers with global infrastructure and real-time analytics.

## Vagon Streams Platform

- [All Features - 3D Application & Pixel Streaming by Vagon Streams](https://vagon.io/streams/features): Complete Vagon Streams features: 4K/60fps, white-label, global coverage
- [Enhanced Analytics - 3D Application & Pixel Streaming by Vagon Streams](https://vagon.io/streams/features/enhanced-analytics): Real-time pixel streaming analytics for monitoring performance & user behavior
- [Black Fantasy Castle | 3D Cloud Pixel Streaming with Vagon Streams](https://vagon.io/streams/experiences/fantasy-castle): Interactive Unreal Engine gothic castle demo streamed via Vagon Streams
- [Hillside ArchViz | 3D Cloud Pixel Streaming with Vagon Streams](https://vagon.io/streams/experiences/hillside): Epic & Safdie Architects ArchViz demo streamed in browser via Vagon

## Cloud Desktop Solutions

- [High Performance Cloud Desktops for Freelancers & Digital Nomads - Vagon](https://vagon.io/users/freelancers): Cloud desktops with NVIDIA RTX for freelancers & digital nomads
- [Team Management - Virtual Desktops for Teams by Vagon](https://vagon.io/teams/features/team-management): Vagon Teams dashboard for managing members, permissions & VMs

## Blender 3D Glossary

- [Blender 3D Glossary: UV Mapping | Vagon Cloud Computers](https://vagon.io/users/digital-art-cgi/blender-3d-glossary/uv-mapping): UV Mapping in Blender: 2D texture application to 3D models
- [Blender 3D Glossary: Sculpt Mode | Vagon Cloud Computers](https://vagon.io/users/digital-art-cgi/blender-3d-glossary/sculpt-mode): Sculpt Mode in Blender: digital sculpting tools for organic modeling
- [Blender 3D Glossary: Subdivision Surface Modifier | Vagon Cloud Computers](https://vagon.io/users/digital-art-cgi/blender-3d-glossary/subdivision-surface-modifier): Subdivision Surface Modifier in Blender: mesh smoothing for detailed models
- [Blender 3D Glossary: Bake Ambient Occlusion | Vagon Cloud Computers](https://vagon.io/users/digital-art-cgi/blender-3d-glossary/bake-ambient-occlusion): Bake Ambient Occlusion in Blender: texture baking for rendering optimization
- [Blender 3D Glossary: Viewport | Vagon Cloud Computers](https://vagon.io/users/digital-art-cgi/blender-3d-glossary/viewport): Viewport in Blender: 3D scene editing workspace with GPU acceleration
